audience: teams that take bookings through NeetoCal scheduling links

useCases.title: Review upcoming bookings
useCases.text: List bookings, filtered by client email or host email. Open one booking to read its time, host, status and payment.

useCases.title: Check open slots for a meeting type
useCases.text: Find the scheduling link, read its durations, then list the open slots for one month in a time zone.

useCases.title: Read payments for a period
useCases.text: List payments for bookings and packages, newest first, within a time range. Use the list for payment reports.

useCases.title: Check team members and holidays
useCases.text: List the team members, their weekly availabilities and the holidays of the workspace.

useCases.title: Reschedule or cancel a booking
useCases.text: Move a booking to a new date and start time. Or set its status to cancelled, approved or rejected. The client sees the change.
